Babe,

This letter is all about you, how amazing you are and how much I wish you could see yourself the way I see you. I wish you would appreciate yourself more and give yourself credit for all the things you do.

I appreciate everything about you. I love how you always encourage me, how you make even our small moments special, and how you always make me feel better whenever things get hard. You make me feel loved and supported in ways I can’t even explain. I’m really thankful to have you.

I just want you to know how proud I am of you. Proud ako sa lahat ng ginagawa mo, sa hard work mo, and even sa mga small things na you think are not that important. I know college and life is not always easy, but you still keep going and I’m really proud of you for that. I’m proud of you for being a good daughter, sister, grandchild, and of course, my amazing girlfriend. I’m so glad they raised you well hehe.

I hope you know that you don’t always have to be strong. It’s okay to get tired, to make mistakes, and to have bad days. I’ll always be here for you, even on days when you don’t feel like yourself. You don’t have to be perfect for me to love you.

I also love your little habits. I love it when you can barely type “jwu” in the morning because you’re still sleepy. I love how bossy you can be sometimes, pero deep inside you have such a soft heart. I love your random stories, your little moods, and even the things you do without realizing how cute they are. (umaakto nalang akong naiinis pero hindi) I hope you never stop being you because I really love those little things about you.

Thank you for always believing in me, especially when I can’t even believe in myself. I’m really happy that I have you in my life. I promise to keep working on myself and be better, because you deserve the best version of me. I know I’m not perfect too, but I’ll always do my best for you and for us.

Please don’t be too hard on yourself, okay? I hope you learn to appreciate yourself more because you deserve that. I hope you see how much you do and how special you are. I wish you could see yourself through my eyes, even just for a moment, so you would understand why I’m so proud and lucky to have you.

Happy birthday, my dearest baby!

I love you so much, babe.
